articles.title: Anthropic CEO calls for AI race to slow down. Musk and OpenAI's Altman agrees
articles.snippet: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei, OpenAI’s Sam Altman and Elon Musk have agreed on an unusual position: frontier AI development may need to slow as systems become capable of helping build their own successors.

articles.title: New Clarity Act text tweaks DeFi, credit union provisions, but road ahead for bill remains murky
articles.snippet: The Clarity Act needs 60 votes when the Senate returns from its recess next week. Republicans circulated a fresh draft on Thursday ahead of the vote.

articles.title: OKX brings OpenAI and Anthropic bets to Europe as pre-IPO trading grows
articles.snippet: The exchange is offering up to 10x leverage on private-company valuations alongside 100 tokenized stocks and ETFs.

articles.title: Revised CLARITY Act targets ‘non-decentralized’ DeFi operators
articles.snippet: The bill’s ethics section remained largely unchanged despite being one of the main points of contention ahead of a pivotal Senate vote.

articles.title: Brevo login flaw enabled phishing email targeting 347K Trezor subscribers
articles.snippet: Trezor told Cointelegraph that the phishing email was sent to 347,000 subscribers and said it is treating every address as “known to the attacker and possibly reusable for phishing.”
